question: Does study time affect exam scores?
data_plan: Generate synthetic student records with study_hours (2-20), prior_gpa (2.0-4.0), sleep_hours (4-9), and exam_score (40-100) where score correlates positively with study_hours and prior_gpa. Label score band (low/med/high) as classification target.
